འཕྲང: narrow passage, defile, a dangerous place on a road ('phrang)

གཏི་མུག: delusion, bewilderment, the not-seeing that is one of the mind's poisons (gti mug)
བསགས་པའི: of what is gathered, which has been gathered (bsags 'gather, pile up', past of gsog, + -pa'i 'of'): a clause placed before its noun
བསུ་མའི: of welcoming, of the welcomer (bsu 'to meet, welcome' + -ma, which makes a noun, perhaps 'the one who welcomes', + -'i 'of'); beside bsu ba'i in the same phrase
དྲུག་ཏུ: among six, as six (drug 'six' + -tu 'among, as'): rigs drug tu 'among the six kinds'; sku drug tu 'as six bodies'
དགག་པའི: of blocking, that blocks (dgag pa 'to block, to stop' + -'i 'of'): a clause placed before its noun
ལྟ་བར: in looking, looking (lta 'look' + -bar): mig ma lta bar 'without looking with the eye'
བཀྲག་མདངས་ཅན: having lustre and radiance, lustrous and radiant (bkrag 'lustre' + mdangs 'glow' + can 'having')
གཏོད: to direct, to aim at, to set upon (gtod): 'dun pa gtod 'direct a longing'
ལད་མོ: imitation, copying (lad mo): lad mo byed 'repeat after someone'
ཀྱཻ་མ: alas! a cry of lament or entreaty at the head of a prayer (kyai ma, the same cry as kye ma)
འཁྱམས་བའི: of wandering, when one wanders ('khyams 'wander' + -ba'i 'of', the print's spelling of -pa'i)
ཆོས་དབྱིངས: expanse of reality (chos 'reality, dharma' + dbyings 'expanse'; short for chos kyi dbyings, Sanskrit dharmadhātu)
ལམ་སྣ: head of the road, the way ahead (lam 'path' + sna 'front, head'): lam sna drongs 'lead the way'
དབྱིངས་ཕྱུག་མ: Lady of the Expanse (dbyings 'expanse' + phyug ma 'rich one, mistress'): the consort of Vairocana, short for Nam mkha'i dbyings phyug ma
ཡིས: by (the 'by' ending after a vowel, used in verse; yis)
སྐྱོར: to hold up, to support (skyor, the present stem, which also serves as the imperative 'hold up!'; past and future bskyor)
བསྒྲལ་དུ: to free, to deliver (bsgral, future stem of sgrol 'to free', + -du): bsgral du gsol 'I pray that you free'

ཡང་དག: true, genuine, perfect (yang dag): yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'true and perfect buddha' (Sanskrit samyaksaṃbuddha)
ས་རུ: to the level, to the stage (sa 'ground, level' + -ru 'to'): the stage a buddha has reached
སྐྱོལ: bring! deliver! (skyol, imperative of skyel 'to bring, to convey')
དེ་སྐད་དུ: thus, in these words (de 'that' + skad 'speech, words' + -du 'in')
ཐུགས་ཀར: in the heart, into the heart (thugs ka 'heart', respectful, + -r 'in, into')
འཇའ་འོད་དུ: as rainbow light, into rainbow light ('ja' 'rainbow' + 'od 'light' + -du 'as, into')
སྟུག་པོ་བཀོད་པའི: of the Densely Arrayed (stug po 'thick, dense' + bkod pa 'arranged, set out', bkod past of 'god + -'i 'of'; Sanskrit Ghanavyūha): the name of a buddha-field, in this book that of the centre
ཞིང་ཁམས་སུ: in the realm, in the buddha-field (zhing khams 'realm' + -su 'in')
ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུ་རུ: as the body of perfect enjoyment (longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'body of perfect enjoyment', the radiant form in which a buddha appears in visions, + -ru 'as')
སངས་རྒྱས་པར: to being a buddha, as a buddha (sangs rgyas 'buddha' + -pa + -r 'to'): sangs rgyas par 'gyur 'become a buddha'
འགྱུར་རོ: becomes, will become ('gyur 'to become, to change' + the sentence-ending -ro)
ཞེ་སྡང: anger, hatred (zhe sdang), the mind's poison of the second day
སྡིག་སྒྲིབ: sinful obscuration, the veil that harmful deeds leave on the mind (sdig 'sin' + sgrib 'obscuration')
རྐྱེན: condition, circumstance, cause (rkyen): rkyen gyis 'through the force of'
རྡོ་རྗེ་སེམས་དཔའི: of Vajrasattva (rdo rje sems dpa' + -'i 'of'): the buddha of the second day
འབྱུང་བ: element, one of the five of which the world is made: earth, water, fire, wind, space ('byung ba, literally 'what arises') · arising, coming about ('byung 'arise' + -ba)
རྣམ་པར: completely, in every way (rnam par): rnam par dag pa 'completely pure'
མངོན་པར་དགའ་བའི: of Manifest Joy (mngon par 'manifestly' + dga' ba 'joy' + -'i 'of'; Sanskrit Abhirati): the buddha-field of the east
རྡོ་རྗེ་སེམས་དཔའ: Vajrasattva, 'Vajra Being' (rdo rje 'vajra' + sems dpa' 'hero of mind'; Sanskrit vajrasattva): the buddha of the second day, here the same figure as Akṣobhya
མི་བསྐྱོད་པ: the Unshakeable (mi 'not' + bskyod 'move, shake' + -pa; Sanskrit Akṣobhya): the buddha of the east
རྡོ་རྗེ: vajra, the diamond-thunderbolt held by deities, emblem of what cannot be broken (rdo rje)
སངས་རྒྱས་སྤྱན་མ: Buddha-Eye (sangs rgyas 'buddha' + spyan 'eye, respectful' + -ma, feminine; Sanskrit Buddhalocanā): the consort of the east
སའི་སྙིང་པོ: Essence of the Earth (sa 'earth' + -'i + snying po 'essence'; Sanskrit Kṣitigarbha): a bodhisattva
བྱམས་པ་མེ་ཏྲི: Maitreya, the Loving One (byams pa 'loving' + me tri, Sanskrit maitri in Tibetan letters): a bodhisattva
སེམས་མ: female bodhisattva (sems ma, short for sems dpa' ma)
ལཱ་སྱ་མ: Lāsyā, 'she of the dance' (lā sya, Sanskrit lāsya 'dance', in Tibetan letters, + -ma, feminine): a female bodhisattva
པུཥྤེ་མ: Puṣpā, 'she of flowers' (puṣpe, the Sanskrit name in the form used in addressing her, from puṣpa 'flower', + -ma, feminine): a female bodhisattva
བསྐོར: surrounded, encircled (bskor, past of skor 'to surround, to circle')
ཀླུང: expanse: the print's spelling of klong (klung as a word by itself is 'river')
གཟུགས: form, the body and all that can be seen (gzugs): the first of the five aggregates
ལྟ་བུའི: like, of the kind of (lta bu 'like' + -'i): me long lta bu'i 'like a mirror'
མཚེར་བ: shimmering (the print's spelling, read as 'tsher ba; mtsher is no known word)
དུད་ཁ: smoke-coloured, smoky (dud 'smoke' + kha 'colour'); the reading is uncertain, perhaps for dud ka
དུ་ཁ: smoky: perhaps the print's short form of dud kha 'smoke-coloured'; the reading is uncertain
འཇིགས་པར: in fear, afraid ('jigs pa 'fear' + -r): ma 'jigs par 'without fear, not fearing'
ཡེ་ཤེས་སུ: as wisdom (ye shes 'wisdom' + -su 'as'): ye shes su ngo shes 'recognise as wisdom'
ཡོངས་པ: uncertain: perhaps 'come', read as 'ongs pa; yongs by itself means 'all, entire', which does not fit here
ལྕགས་ཀྱུ: iron hook (lcags 'iron' + kyu 'hook'): the hook by which the light of compassion draws one out
བཟོད་པའི: of bearing, that can be borne (bzod pa 'bearing' + -'i 'of'): mi bzod pa'i 'unbearable'
འདམ་དུ: into mud, into a mire ('dam 'mud, mire' + -du 'into')
ཚུད: to get into, to be caught in, to sink into (tshud)
བལྟ་བར: in looking, looking (blta, future stem of lta 'look', + -bar): mig ma blta bar 'without looking with the eye'
སྤོངས་ཤིག: give up! (spongs, imperative of spong 'give up', + shig, which marks a command)
སངས་རྒྱས་སྤྱན་མས: by Buddha-Eye, by Buddhalocanā (sangs rgyas spyan ma + -s 'by')
བསྐྱོར: held up, to hold up, support (bskyor, past and future stem of skyor 'hold up'); in a request, perhaps standing for 'hold up!'
མངོན་བར་དགའ་བའི: of Manifest Joy (mngon bar, the print's spelling of mngon par 'manifestly', + dga' ba 'joy' + -'i 'of')
ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུར: as the body of perfect enjoyment (longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku + -r 'as')
ང་རྒྱལ: pride (nga 'I' + rgyal 'to win'): the mind's poison of the third day
རིན་ཆེན་འབྱུང་ལྡན: Source of Jewels (rin chen 'jewel, precious thing' + 'byung ldan 'having arising'; Sanskrit Ratnasambhava): the buddha of the south and of the third day
ལྡན་པའི: of the endowed, endowed with (ldan pa 'having' + -'i 'of'): dpal dang ldan pa'i 'endowed with glory'
རིན་པོ་ཆེ: precious, a precious thing, jewel (rin 'value' + po + che 'great')
མཱ་མ་ཀི: Māmakī, 'She Who Is Mine': a Sanskrit name in Tibetan letters, the consort of the south
ནམ་མཁའི་སྙིང་པོ: Essence of Space (nam mkha' 'sky, space' + -'i + snying po 'essence'; Sanskrit Ākāśagarbha): a bodhisattva
མཱ་ལྱམ: Mālyā, 'she of the garland' (mā lyam, the print's letters for a Sanskrit name from mālya 'garland'; the other recension has mā le ma): a female bodhisattva
དྷུ་པེ་མ: Dhūpā, 'she of incense' (dhu pe, for Sanskrit dhūpe, the name in the form used in addressing her, from dhūpa 'incense', + -ma, feminine): a female bodhisattva
ཚོར་བའི: of feeling (tshor ba 'feeling' + -'i 'of'): feeling is the second of the five aggregates
དག་བ: pure, being pure (dag ba, the print's spelling of dag pa)
ཐིག་ལེ: drop, sphere, point of light (thig le)
བརྒྱན་པ: adorned, decorated (brgyan, past of rgyan 'to adorn', + -pa)
བལྟ: to look (blta, future stem of lta 'look'): blta mi bzod pa 'unbearable to look at'
ཐད་ཀར: straight at, level with (thad ka 'straight toward' + -r): snying gi thad kar 'at the level of the heart'
གཤིབ་མར: side by side (the print's other spelling of gshibs mar)
སྙིང་ཁར: at the heart, into the heart (snying kha 'heart' + -r 'at, into')
བྲོས་སུ: fleeing, in flight (bros, past of 'bros 'to flee', + -su): bros su 'ong 'will flee'
ཆགས་སེམས: a mind of attachment, desire (chags 'be attached' + sems 'mind')
བྱར་མེད: with nothing to do, effortless (bya, future stem of byed 'do', 'to be done', + -r + med 'there is not')
བཞོགས་ཤིག: rest! leave it! (bzhogs + shig, which marks a command; perhaps the print's form for zhog, imperative of 'jog 'place, leave')
དབྱེར་མེད་དུ: inseparably, without being apart (dbyer med 'without separation' + -du)
